notes.title: 1st Anniversary Patch, version 0.56
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125028/a24693a91726bf051d553fee2f0c76fd2d901205.png"][/img]

To all aspiring kingpings, godmothers and gangbosses,

Today marks the first anniversary of ALL IN THE GAME's early-access launch! After the lead developer's stint as a public servant, development has resumed for the summer. To give everyone a taste of what's to come, here are the patch notes to the recently released version 0.56.1750857988 of our game.

[u]New content[/u] [/p][list][*][p]Added a new building type: [b]Mall[/b]. Mall has a base property value of $5,000. It holds 1x Utility, 1x Streetside and 3x Commercial Amenity slots and 2x Activity slots. It provides +3 daily Black Market purchases to its owner. It can be targeted by Store Robbery, Claim Turf, Auto Theft, Pickpocket, Bling Recruitment, Fencing and Controlled Demolition.[/p][/*][/list][p] [u]Balance[/u] [/p][list][*][p]Increased the base daily [b]Black Market purchases[/b] from 1 to 2,[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced the [b]Factory Break-In[/b] Operation: Reduced Chemicals yield from 8 to 5, Clothes yield from 6 to 4 and Spray Paint yield from 9 to 4. Reduced base risk chance from 30% to 20% and Stealth cost from 30 to 20.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the minimum RP yield from the [b]Recruitment Campaign[/b] Assignment by 1[/p][/*][/list][p] [u]Quality of life[/u] [/p][list][*][p]Added a radial bar around Turn Agenda circle to better gauge how much time player has used during their turn,[/p][/*][/list][p] [u]Bugs and issues[/u] [/p][list][*][p]Some of the bugfixes that were implemented back in 2024 weren't registered to the change log, so I don't remember all of them. Overall, the game should be a bit more stable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several minor issues such as typos, misleading information and interface problems[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue when loading a save causes a crash caused by turn timer not resetting properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused some tutorials to crash when initiated[/p][/*][/list][p] [u]Graphics[/u] [/p][list][*][p]All Amenities now have a unique icon rather than sharing the same slot icon[/p][/*][*][p]Activity draggables now have their respective backdrop in their frame[/p][/*][*][p]Made some slight improvements on the Activity icons[/p][/*][*][p]Added slightly improved sprites for the Soldier-type Lieutenant[/p][/*][/list][p] [u]Miscellaneous[/u] [/p][list][*][p]Set the default timer setting as No Timer[/p][/*][*][p]Added a proper Manual entry for the Forgery Assignment[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added a new building type: [b]Mall[/b]. Mall has a base property value of $5,000. It holds 1x Utility, 1x Streetside and 3x Commercial Amenity slots and 2x Activity slots. It provides +3 daily Black Market purchases to its owner. It can be targeted by Store Robbery, Claim Turf, Auto Theft, Pickpocket, Bling Recruitment, Fencing and Controlled Demolition.

tags.balance_change: Increased the base daily [b]Black Market purchases[/b] from 1 to 2,

Rebalanced the [b]Factory Break-In[/b] Operation: Reduced Chemicals yield from 8 to 5, Clothes yield from 6 to 4 and Spray Paint yield from 9 to 4. Reduced base risk chance from 30% to 20% and Stealth cost from 30 to 20.
Increased the minimum RP yield from the [b]Recruitment Campaign[/b] Assignment by 1

tags.feature: Added a radial bar around Turn Agenda circle to better gauge how much time player has used during their turn,

tags.bug: Fixed several minor issues such as typos, misleading information and interface problems
Fixed an issue when loading a save causes a crash caused by turn timer not resetting properly
Fixed an issue that caused some tutorials to crash when initiated

tags.feature: All Amenities now have a unique icon rather than sharing the same slot icon
Activity draggables now have their respective backdrop in their frame
Made some slight improvements on the Activity icons
Added slightly improved sprites for the Soldier-type Lieutenant
Set the default timer setting as No Timer
Added a proper Manual entry for the Forgery Assignment
